content:
[EPISODE]
Situation:
ABC Logistics concerned about initial implementation budget

Objection:
Implementation cost too high

Tactic:
Offered 3-phase modular rollout starting with pilot phase

Customer reaction:
Agreed to Phase 1 pilot evaluation

Outcome:
won

Why:
Phased pilot de-risked upfront capital expenditure

Applies when:
Enterprise sales negotiations

Did not hold when:
When competitor offers 30% lower price parity

Lesson:
Structure enterprise quotes with phase 1 pilot options when price resistance occurs

Pricing context:
₹12L initial quote, closed at ₹10L

account_executive (confirmed)

Valid as of:
2026-08-15
